//: Story Phase 14: the Grand Bank's depositors, summoned by the branch out of Stenchmaster haze. Data first: adding one is an entry here and two little scripts (intro, after). intensity is the bank's scale (1-10, or '10+'); classify is what the ledger offers; pattern is the teller's window (take the sash, hold it in the band, wait, a harmless puff, BRACE when the rings meet).

windabella.name: Grand Duchess Windabella the Imperious
windabella.title: Grand Duchess of the Upper Breezes, Keeper of the Crimson Sash

pattern.text: She holds out a crimson sash the size of a tablecloth, and waits for you to take it, because she has never in her life had to wait.
Hold it. She is not to be hurried.

windabella.notes: Furniture-moving. Table moved four feet. Did not apologise. Did not look.

gassius.name: Sir Gassius Thunderbottom
gassius.title: Knight of the Ceremonial Bean, Thunderbottom of Thunderbottom Hall

pattern.text: A family diet of burnt pepper. Three hundred years of it.

gassius.notes: Structural. Crack in mainmast (small). Smelled of pepper for an hour.

rumblewaft.name: Lady Rumblewaft the Resolute
rumblewaft.title: Holder of the Long Waft, Patience of the Southern Shore

pattern.text: It isn't strong. It just doesn't stop.

milestones.text: Still going. Your arms have started to ache.
STILL going. Jim brings you a stool. You can't sit on it. You're holding a sash.
Gristle has started a second watch.

rumblewaft.notes: Furniture-aware. Duration: 1 hour 14 min (estimated). Arms gone. Tea made twice.

puffington.name: Lord Puffington the Enduring
puffington.title: Lord Puffington the Enduring, Ninety-Seven, Eater of Fibre
puffington.telegraph: Very old. Very frail. Seems quite harmless.

pattern.text: His hand shakes, passing it over. Such a nice old man.
Gentle. Hardly anything. Poor old soul.
...oh no.

puffington.notes: MARITIME. HE IS NINETY-SEVEN. Fibre. (Do not trust the old ones.)

breezella.name: Grand Stenchmistress Breezella the Bold
breezella.title: Grand Stenchmistress of Acceleration, Youngest Ever Certified
breezella.telegraph: Fast. Then, a moment later: FAST.

pattern.label: FWIP!
pattern.text: A short, sharp one. Is that it? That's it.
...nothing...
And here comes the rest of it.

breezella.notes: Structural, delayed. The wave comes LATER. Watch for the wave.

gustavius.name: Little Grand Gustavius
gustavius.title: Apprentice Grand Stenchmaster (Junior Division)
gustavius.telegraph: A small boy in an enormous sash.

pattern.text: The sash trails three yards behind him. He has a paper crown.
Easy. He's only little.

gustavius.notes: Maritime. Aged seven and three quarters. 'The secret is beans.' (It is.)

puffalina.name: Grand Toddler Puffalina
puffalina.title: Grand Toddler, Heiress to the Little Breeze

pattern.text: She holds out a tiny sash. And a stuffed skunk. You take the sash.

pattern.label: pt.
pattern.text: A tiny little puff. Aww.
She's very pleased with herself. Too pleased.
WAIT.

puffalina.notes: MUNICIPAL. AGED TWO. The second one. ALWAYS the second one.

ventworth.name: Dr. Flatulon Ventworth
ventworth.title: Professor of Applied Atmospherics, Fellow of the Grand Society

pattern.text: Perfectly even. Perfectly steady. The same note, held.

milestones.text: The ship has started to HUM. At his frequency.

windledger.name: Madame Windledger
windledger.title: Grand Auditor of the Grand Trust
windledger.telegraph: She is looking at your handwriting.

pattern.text: She is reading the ledger upside down while you hold it.

windledger.notes: Structural. Moved the COUNTER. With me behind it. My fives are FINE.

gasbeth.name: Captain Gasbeth
gasbeth.title: Pirate Grand Stenchmaster, Terror of the Windward Isles
gasbeth.telegraph: Another captain. She's eyeing your cannons.

pattern.text: She grins at you over the sash, one captain to another.

gasbeth.notes: Maritime. Fired a cannon. One captain to another: respect.

thundergut.name: Baron Thundergut
thundergut.title: Baron Thundergut, Triple-Sash Certified
thundergut.telegraph: Huge. Three sashes. You have to hold all three.

pattern.text: One sash.
Two sashes.
THREE sashes. Your arms are full of sash.
Pete has your belt. Gristle has Pete. Bob has Gristle. A human chain.

thundergut.notes: Municipal. Three sashes. Human chain: Pete, Gristle, Bob, Jim, Ned. (Squawks supervised.)

duke_puff.name: Grand Miniature Duke Puff
duke_puff.title: Grand Miniature Duke, Master of Concentrated Output

pattern.label: PT.
pattern.text: A tiny 'PT.' That's all. That's...
...FOCUSED.

duke_puff.notes: Maritime. 'PT.' Then the BELL. Split in two. From across the DECK.

wind_twins.name: The Grand Wind Twins
wind_twins.title: Joint Account Holders, the Synchronised Sashes of Breezemouth

pattern.text: The left twin's sash.
The right twin's sash.
Two sashes, pulling two ways.
Both at once. They meet in the middle. The middle is you.

wind_twins.notes: Maritime. Two waves. They met in me. Beard: vertical (temporarily).

rumpington.name: Grand Duke Rumpington
rumpington.title: Grand Duke Rumpington of the Lower Rumps, Hereditary Bench-Warmer
rumpington.telegraph: A great deal of velvet. A great deal of man.

pattern.text: He sighs, theatrically, the whole time.

rumpington.notes: Structural. Ned on his back. Ned fine.

beatrice.name: Beatrice of the Violet Sash
beatrice.title: Beatrice of the Violet Sash
beatrice.telegraph: A violet sash. A very nice violet sash.

pattern.text: She hums while you hold it. Quite a nice tune.

beatrice.notes: Furniture-moving. Pleasant. Coils neater after. (The only nice one.)

gary.name: Gary
gary.title: Grand High Exalted Ambassador of the Tempestuous Bottom, Viscount of the Seventh Gust, Keeper of the Eternal Bean

pattern.text: He looks completely ordinary.
GARY.

zephyrella.name: Grand Empress Zephyrella the Uncontainable
zephyrella.title: Grand Empress of the Four Winds, Mover of the Mount of Oomph

pattern.text: Her sash comes down out of the haze like a curtain.
The sky dims. The storm leans in to watch.

zephyrella.notes: HISTORIC. The storm STOPPED. (One breath.) Mountain: seven feet, apparently.

rumbleseptimus.name: Grand Patriarch Rumbleseptimus the World-Weary
rumbleseptimus.title: Grand Patriarch of the First Rumble, Continental Class (Retired)

pattern.text: His sash is made of something that might be moss.
He sighs. The sea sighs with him.
He's gathering himself. It takes a geological age.

rumbleseptimus.notes: PLEASE NOTIFY AUTHORITIES. A continent moved. He was BORED.

gustilda.name: Grandmother Gustilda
gustilda.title: (no title)

pattern.text: A little old woman in a cardigan. A plain grey sash, knitted. She hands it over kindly.
She's smiling at you.

pattern.label: hm.
pattern.text: A little sigh, settling in.
And then it STARTS.

milestones.text: The counter's LIFTING. Off the deck.
You're lifting with it. Your boots are off the deck.
Every pirate on the ship has hold of your legs.

gustilda.notes: VALUE: UNMEASURABLE. 10+. ABSOLUTELY NOT. She wanted a RECEIPT.
